header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners; nor intimation received.
body: Perusal of prayer clauses reflects that instant Petition was only filed with prayer to restrain the private respondents from harassing the petitioners and to direct the official respondents to provide protection to them.
Learned A.A.G submits that official respondents are duty bound to act strictly in accordance with law.
In view of above, instant petition is disposed of with direction to the official respondents to provide protection to the petitioners as and when required and to act strictly in accordance with law.
